identity.name: Explorer II
identity.one_liner: The 2011-2021 Explorer II: 42mm, caliber 3187, and the orange 24-hour hand restored.

narrative.story: Launched for the Explorer II's 40th anniversary, the 216570 grew the case to 42mm and brought back the orange 24-hour hand of the original 1655. The maxi case and oversized handset made it the most visible Explorer II yet, and the Polar white version became the configuration most associated with the modern model.
narrative.collector_notes: Polar trades above black. The steel 24-hour bezel scratches faster than ceramic — check it and the white dial for even aging.
